turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you comfortable with how I am speaking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Please talk a bit slower, my hearing is poor.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I drove her over, I will listen along.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What brings you to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Something is wrong with my chest, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel it in your left arm or in your jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I feel it in my jaw sometimes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What kind of sensation is it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: This morning, while I was making tea.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took an antacid and it did not do anything.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My daughter lives far away. I am afraid to be alone if this happens again.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: That matters. We will talk about who you can call and when to call for help.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only when I hurry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you blacked out at all?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is your breathing affected?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No trouble breathing at all.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you been sweating with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any history of diabetes, blood pressure problems or cholesterol problems, or do you smoke?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have diabetes. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any heart problems in your close relatives?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nobody that I remember.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you had any procedure on your heart before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have never had any.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What are you taking at home for your health?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Metformin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: To finish, here is the plan. First, take one baby aspirin every morning. Second, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. To be sure I was clear, what will you do next?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will take one baby aspirin each morning and get the heart tracing and the blood test today.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I will remind her.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any other questions before you go?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing else, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Okay, that is everything for today. Take care.
